title: NCAA: Chris Hubilla powers JRU over EAC to sustain form
summary: It was Chris Hubilla’s big night that powered Jose Rizal University past Emilio Aguinaldo College, 84-74, in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Monday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
